headline: Two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws join CISA KEV; record $6.3B Binance theft and exploited GitLab RCE stay on the board

bullets.text: New: CISA added two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to KEV on 2026-10-30: missing authentication for a critical function (CVE-2026-111357, due 2026-11-02) and predictable identifiers (CVE-2026-118527, due 2026-11-13).
North Korea-linked hackers are blamed for the record $6.3 billion Binance theft. Binance links it to a compromised DevOps laptop and The Hacker News says nearly $3 billion has been frozen.
CISA says max-severity GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229 is exploited (KEV due 2026-11-01). Drupal Commerce Core authorization bypass CVE-2026-118539 is also exploited.
A trojanized Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace planted persistent SSH backdoors; separately, Polymarket traders lost $2M+ in a supply-chain attack via a third-party provider.
Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS zero-day CVE-2026-76418 is exploited (KEV due 2026-11-01); Cisco SD-WAN CVE-2026-20127 is exploited to deploy KeyDrift malware.
Florida says SSNs of 4.9 million people leaked in a financial aid site breach. China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709 and chained PHP2Shell to compromise Palo Alto firewalls.

actions: Patch Ivanti Connect Secure for CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 now and review appliance logs for unauthenticated access.
Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 today and review logs for exploitation.
Patch Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01; patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 and hunt for KeyDrift malware.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
Review what single developer or DevOps laptops can reach in production; Binance traced its theft to one compromised DevOps laptop.
Apply Linux kernel fixes for CVE-2026-46300 (KEV due 2026-10-31), patch Drupal Commerce for CVE-2026-118539 and VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709.
